name: intelligent-code-agents
description: ICA cross-platform interactive installer, CLI, and dashboard

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/installer-core/catalog/generateCatalog.js && npm run build:dashboard:web
scripts.build:desktop:preview: npm run build:quick && npm run build:dashboard:web
scripts.build:desktop:release: npm run build:desktop:preview && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.build:desktop:publish: npm run build:desktop:preview && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --publish always
scripts.start:desktop:dev: npm run build:quick && ICA_DESKTOP_MODE=dev electron dist/src/desktop-electron/app.js
scripts.build:quick: npm run clean:compiled-tests && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/installer-core/catalog/generateCatalog.js
scripts.test: npm run build:quick && node --test dist/tests/installer/*.test.js && bash tests/run-tests.sh
